# NXCSOL

> Software development company in Kalispell, Montana building SaaS platforms, Three.js 3D websites, custom business software, AI automation and iOS and Android apps.

NXCSOL LLC, 1001 S. Main St. Ste 600, Kalispell, MT 59901, USA. Email hello@nxcsol.com, phone +1 (209) 807-4007, WhatsApp +1 (406) 300-5434. Founder: Usman Nadeem.

## Services

- [SaaS platforms](https://nxcsol.com/services/saas-development/): NXCSOL builds SaaS platforms and MVPs: sign-up, Stripe billing, role-based dashboards, admin panels and AI analytics on Next.js, Node.js and PostgreSQL.
- [Three.js and 3D web](https://nxcsol.com/services/threejs-3d-web-development/): Three.js development services: 3D product viewers and configurators, scroll-driven film and WebGL particle scenes that still load fast on phones.
- [Custom software](https://nxcsol.com/services/custom-software-development/): Custom software for operations: fleet and facility management systems, admin panels, CRMs and dashboards, built around how your business actually runs.
- [AI and workflow automation](https://nxcsol.com/services/ai-workflow-automation/): AI and workflow automation services: n8n and Make workflows, email automation, LinkedIn and YouTube content pipelines, and custom bots for your business.
- [Mobile apps](https://nxcsol.com/services/mobile-app-development/): iOS and Android app development with React Native and Expo: sign-in, payments, chat, maps and live tracking, plus the backend and App Store releases.
- [Claude skills](https://nxcsol.com/services/claude-skills-development/): NXCSOL writes custom Claude Code skills and plugins around your team's process, with eval cases, versioned releases and clear limits on what each skill can do.
- [3D rendering and Blender](https://nxcsol.com/services/3d-rendering-blender/): 3D rendering in Blender from NXCSOL: product stills and turntables, short animation, and optimised glTF models ready for Three.js websites.

## Case studies

- [The Derma Club Clinic Website and Online Booking](https://nxcsol.com/work/dermaclub/): A 31-page website rebrand for a Mississauga skin clinic, with 20 treatment pages, a 51-product shop and an online booking system built to replace Jane.
- [Obyect AI Ad-Insights SaaS Platform](https://nxcsol.com/work/obyect/): How we built Obyect, a curated library of 2,400+ winning DTC ads with boards, creative requests, admin curation and analytics on React and Supabase.
- [Dr Solar 3D Scroll Website and Shopify Theme](https://nxcsol.com/work/dr-solar/): A scroll-driven website for a solar installer: one house turns from day to night while the power runs through it, with a sizing calculator on a Shopify theme.
- [Atomic Muscles 3D E-commerce Store (Three.js)](https://nxcsol.com/work/atomic-muscles/): Case study: a scroll-driven Three.js storefront for a supplement brand, with 3D product viewers, Shopify checkout and English and Urdu support.
- [Fleet Management Software for 580+ Vehicles](https://nxcsol.com/work/fleet-management-system/): A custom fleet management system tracking 580+ vehicles across 12+ cities, with live tracking, fuel anomaly flags, maintenance and role-based access.
- [iFund Real Estate Funding App (React Native)](https://nxcsol.com/work/ifund/): A two-sided iOS and Android marketplace for property funding: scored lender matches, a leads pipeline, in-app chat, Face ID and subscriptions.
- [GaragePal Auto-Service App and Garage Dashboard](https://nxcsol.com/work/garagepal/): An auto-service marketplace in Canada and Qatar: a driver app to find, book and track garage services, plus a web dashboard for garage owners.
- [Facility Management Software Case Study](https://nxcsol.com/work/facility-management-system/): A facility management system for the SaudiPak tower: complaints, job slips, tenants, plant-room logs and CCTV for 260+ users across 6 roles.
- [Karighar Home-Services Booking App UI/UX](https://nxcsol.com/work/karighar/): A home-services app redesign: book verified plumbers and electricians, track them on a live map and pay cash, in a calm light and dark interface.
- [ZestLead Real Estate Lead Marketplace SaaS](https://nxcsol.com/work/zestlead/): A SaaS marketplace where real estate agents preview, buy and manage property leads, with audio previews, Stripe subscriptions and an admin panel.
- [Subyect Creative Agency Website (Next.js)](https://nxcsol.com/work/subyect/): A scroll-driven Next.js and Framer Motion website for a DTC static-ad agency, telling its method, its named client results and its in-house ad library.

## Guides and tutorials

- [How to Build a 3D Product Viewer with Three.js](https://nxcsol.com/guides/threejs-3d-product-viewer/): A step-by-step Three.js tutorial with working code: a 3D product viewer that turns on drag, scrolls properly on phones and falls back to an image.
- [How to Keep a 3D Website Fast on Phones](https://nxcsol.com/guides/fast-3d-websites-on-phones/): What we learned building Three.js sites that run on phones: when to load 3D, what to cap, and the one-line scroll bug that cost us over a second.
- [How to Export a Blender Model for the Web (glTF)](https://nxcsol.com/guides/blender-gltf-for-web/): How to get a Blender model onto a website: clean it up, bake procedural materials, export it as glTF, then shrink the file with one command.
- [n8n vs Make vs Zapier: Which Should You Use?](https://nxcsol.com/guides/n8n-vs-make-vs-zapier/): How n8n, Make and Zapier really differ: how each one bills, what a five-step workflow costs in usage, and when you need custom code instead.
- [n8n Tutorial: Automatic Lead Follow-Up by Email](https://nxcsol.com/guides/n8n-lead-follow-up-tutorial/): Build an n8n workflow that catches a form submission, alerts your team and emails the lead straight away. Steps, test commands and what to do next.
- [LinkedIn and YouTube Automation: What Is Allowed](https://nxcsol.com/guides/linkedin-youtube-automation-rules/): What LinkedIn and YouTube's own rules say about automation, what can get an account restricted or demonetized, and what is safe for creators to automate.
